# Fire

Sprite-sheet animation, soft particles, particle lights, and a heat-distortion subsystem.

[View live example](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/?preset=Fire)

Preset by [rzmay](https://github.com/rzmay).

![Generated preview of Fire](https://rzmps.rzmay.com/docs/previews/fire.png)

## Particle System Configuration

The 10-second loop schedules a continuous flame; individual flame particles last only 1.35 seconds. The shorter particle lifetime keeps the flame near its source while the secondary distortion system supplies a separate one-second heat shimmer. Inheritance is disabled for the shimmer’s appearance so its scale and opacity do not collapse with the flame.


[Source: system:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L28)

```js
  const fire = new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 10,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: new EmissionShape({
          geometry: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1.7, 24),
          source: EmissionSource.Surface,
        }),
        rate: 90,
        radialSpeed: 0.2,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: 1.35,
          speed: 1.2,
          scale: 2.5,
          color: ['#ff9c88', '#ffd47f'],
          alpha: 0.95,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.2, 0),
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.25, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: 2.1,
        frequency: 1.35,
      }),
      new ForceOverLifetime({
        force: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (1.3 + (0.2 - 1.3) * time);
          return size;
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        color: '#ffffff',
        alpha: (time) => ((time) < 0.2 ? (time) / 0.2 : (time) < 0.75 ? 1 - 0.15 * (((time) - 0.2) / 0.55) : 0.85 * (1 - (((time) - 0.75) / 0.25))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [new THREE.Vector3(-0.5, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0, 0)],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(fireSprite, {
        gridSize: { x: 8, y: 4 },
        frames: 32,
        fps: 24,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
      }),
      new LightRenderer({
        count: 18,
        ratio: 0.3,
        randomDistribution: true,
        inheritParticleColor: true,
        sizeAffectsRange: true,
        alphaAffectsIntensity: true,
        brightness: 1.8,
        rangeMultiplier: 3,
        lightOptions: {
          color: '#ffb570',
          intensity: 1,
          distance: 8,
          decay: 2,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


[Source: system:2](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L132)

```js
  return new ParticleSystem({
    duration: 1,
    looping: true,
    emitters: [
      new Emitter({
        source: EmissionShape.Sphere(0.05, 8, 6),
        rate: options.rate,
        radialSpeed: 1,
        initialValues: {
          lifetime: options.lifetime,
          scale: options.scale,
          velocity: new THREE.Vector3(0, options.velocity, 0),
          color: '#ffffff',
          rotation: [
            new THREE.Vector3(-Math.PI, 0, 0),
            new THREE.Vector3(Math.PI, 0, 0),
          ],
        },
      }),
    ],
    modules: [
      new VelocityOverLifetime({
        linear: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0),
      }),
      new TransformByNoise({
        strength: new THREE.Vector3(0.65, 0.35, 0.65),
        frequency: 1.7,
      }),
      new ScaleOverLifetime({
        scale: (time) => {
          const size = (0.35 + (1.8 - 0.35) * time) * (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time, 0, 1)));
          return size;
        },
      }),
      new ColorOverLifetime({
        alpha: (time) => Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(time * 5, 0, 1)) * (1 - Easing.cubic.in(THREE.MathUtils.clamp((time - 0.8) * 5, 0, 1))),
      }),
      new RotationOverLifetime({
        angularVelocity: [
          new THREE.Vector3(-0.45, 0, 0),
          new THREE.Vector3(0.45, 0, 0),
        ],
      }),
    ],
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(Textures.Default, {
        alphaMap,
        softParticleDistance: 2.5,
        materialOptions: {
          transmission: 1,
          distortionMap,
          distortionStrength: 0.05,
          depthWrite: false,
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
```


## Emitters

A cone surface spreads the base of the flame. At 90 particles per second and a 1.35-second lifetime, the main population is roughly 122 sprites before culling. Upward velocity 2.2 and radial speed 0.2 make vertical flow dominate the horizontal spread; the 2.5-unit scale lets adjacent sprites overlap.

Uniform scale values and color strings use the standard input shortcuts.

## Modules

Noise strength 2.1 and frequency 1.35 break up the regular rise. The additional upward force bends the motion over time, while the scale multiplier shrinks from 1.3 to 0.2. The alpha curve fades in during the first fifth of life and fades out over the final quarter, hiding sprite births and deaths. The distortion subsystem uses gentler noise and its own grow-and-fade curve.

## Renderers

The 8×4 atlas contains 32 flame frames played at 24 fps, approximately one animation across the 1.35-second life. Soft-particle distance 1 blends intersections. Particle lights are limited to 18 with ratio 0.3, avoiding a light per sprite. The secondary sprite transmits the background with distortion strength 0.05 and disables depth writing so the shimmer does not occlude the flame.


[Source: renderers:1](https://github.com/rzmay/rzmps/blob/develop/examples/fire.js#L79)

```js
    renderers: [
      new SpriteRenderer(fireSprite, {
        gridSize: { x: 8, y: 4 },
        frames: 32,
        fps: 24,
        softParticleDistance: 1,
      }),
      new LightRenderer({
        count: 18,
        ratio: 0.3,
        randomDistribution: true,
        inheritParticleColor: true,
```
